title: Director of Sales

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: The Director of Sales for Ricoh's wide-format printing division directly owns revenue targets and customer relationships with PSPs, sign manufacturers, and vehicle wrap installers - the exact companies that purchase Tedlar overlaminates. This role is measured on equipment sales, customer acquisition, and account expansion. By incorporating Tedlar into their sales conversations and potentially offering bundled solutions or qualified referrals, they can differentiate Ricoh printers on total cost of ownership and output durability rather than just print quality specs. When selling a $100K+ Pro L5160e printer, being able to recommend Tedlar as the protective film that ensures their customers' printed graphics last 12-20+ years outdoors creates a compelling value story that justifies premium pricing. This role personally benefits from reduced customer churn (fewer complaints about print durability), higher close rates in competitive deals, and expansion opportunities with existing accounts. Given Ricoh serves 1.4M businesses including Fortune 500 companies, this role would see Tedlar partnership as a competitive weapon and customer retention tool.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: [Name] owns revenue generation and customer relationships for Ricoh's wide-format printing division, specifically the Pro L5160e latex and Pro TF6251 printers used for outdoor signage, vehicle wraps, exhibition graphics, and POP displays. They manage a sales team selling $100K+ printing equipment to PSPs, sign manufacturers, and commercial print shops - the exact buyers of Tedlar protective films. This role influences equipment purchase decisions and post-sale customer success, likely reporting to a VP of Sales or Commercial Printing Division Head. They have authority over sales strategy, customer engagement approaches, and partnership initiatives that drive equipment sales and account expansion.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Given Ricoh's Pro L5160e and Pro TF6251 target outdoor applications including vehicle wraps, exhibition graphics, and outdoor signage, [Name]'s customers face the exact durability challenges Tedlar solves. When selling printers for vehicle wrap production, they can position Tedlar's graffiti resistance and UV protection as essential to their customers' warranty programs. For PSPs producing outdoor signage and architectural graphics, Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan directly reduces their total cost of ownership and callback rates. For customers printing POP displays and retail graphics, Tedlar's weather resistance (-70°F to 230°F) ensures consistent quality across diverse installation environments. By recommending Tedlar as the protective overlaminate for Ricoh printer output, [Name] transforms equipment sales conversations from print quality specs to total solution value.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] is measured on equipment sales revenue, new customer acquisition, account retention rates, and competitive win rates against HP, Canon, and Epson in the large-format space. They personally care about deal differentiation - when competing on similar print quality and speed specs, being able to offer guidance on protective films that extend output lifespan by 12-20+ years creates tangible competitive advantage. Customer complaints about UV fading or warranty claims on printed graphics damage equipment sales relationships and future expansion opportunities. Tedlar addresses this by ensuring Ricoh's printer customers achieve durable, long-lasting results, reducing post-sale complaints and strengthening [Name]'s customer relationships. Higher customer satisfaction directly impacts their team's ability to expand within accounts and generate referrals.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Ricoh exhibited at PRINTING United Expo 2025 in Orlando (October 22-24) and consistently participates in major industry trade shows, indicating active market engagement and customer-facing activity. Their focus on serving 85% of Fortune 500 companies suggests premium positioning and emphasis on total solution value rather than price competition. The commercial printing market's increasing focus on outdoor durability and sustainability makes NOW the right time to position Tedlar as a strategic advantage - before competitors establish similar protective film partnerships. Recent launches of the Pro L5160e and Pro TF6251 for outdoor applications create natural conversation opportunities around ensuring customer success with these new products.
